description.zh: 从请求进入服务，到第一个 token 返回。理解 prefill、decode、KV cache 和延迟指标。
description.en: Follow a request from arrival to its first token. Explore prefill, decode, KV cache and latency metrics.

outcome.zh: 一份推理系统解读与实验计划
outcome.en: A system walkthrough and experiment plan

task.zh: 阅读官方文档，画出队列、prefill、decode 与响应的关系。用自己的话解释 TTFT、每 token 延迟和吞吐量为什么不能相互替代。
task.en: Read the official documentation. Draw the queue, prefill, decode and response stages. Explain why TTFT, per-token latency and throughput answer different questions.

evidence.zh: 提交架构图和一页指标说明，注明资料版本与日期。
evidence.en: Publish a diagram and one-page metrics guide with source versions and dates.

title.zh: 估算 KV cache 占用

task.zh: 选择一种标准 Transformer 架构，列出层数、KV heads、head dimension、精度、序列长度和并发数，估算 KV cache 占用，并说明架构差异会如何改变假设。
task.en: For a standard Transformer, record layers, KV heads, head dimension, precision, sequence length and concurrency. Estimate KV cache memory and explain the architecture assumptions.

evidence.zh: 提交计算脚本、单位说明和两组可复算样例。
evidence.en: Publish a calculation script, units and two reproducible examples.

task.zh: 写出固定模型、硬件、版本、输入输出长度和请求分布的测试方案。区分冷启动、预热和缓存命中；没有设备时交付方案，不编造结果。
task.en: Specify model, hardware, versions, input/output lengths and request distribution. Separate cold starts, warm-up and cache hits. Without hardware, submit the plan without fabricated results.

evidence.zh: 提交实验计划、预期限制和待验证问题。
evidence.en: Publish a plan, limitations and open questions.

subtitle.zh: 从启动服务到读懂瓶颈

description.zh: 围绕一个可复现的推理服务，学习部署、批处理、性能测量与可观测性。
description.en: Build a reproducible inference service and explore deployment, batching, measurement and observability.

outcome.zh: 一个服务仓库与基准测试报告
outcome.en: A serving repository and benchmark report

task.zh: 按与你所选版本匹配的官方指南，选择有权使用且能装入设备的模型，运行一次请求。记录框架、模型 revision、驱动和设备信息；没有设备可先完成配置评审。
task.en: Use the guide for your chosen release and a model you can use and fit on your hardware. Run a request and record framework, model revision, drivers and devices. Without hardware, review the configuration first.

evidence.zh: 提交可复现 README、启动配置与脱敏示例。
evidence.en: Publish a reproducible README, launch configuration and sanitized example.

task.zh: 固定输入输出长度，测试至少三档并发，记录 TTFT、输出 token 吞吐和失败率。重复实验并报告 p50、p95 和原始记录。
task.en: Hold input/output lengths fixed. Test at least three concurrency levels and record TTFT, output-token throughput and failure rate. Repeat runs and report p50, p95 and raw observations.

evidence.zh: 提交脚本、原始数据、图表和一段瓶颈分析。
evidence.en: Publish scripts, raw data, plots and a bottleneck analysis.

title.en: Turn the result into a portfolio

task.zh: 解释一项配置变化的收益与代价，包括显存、尾延迟或失败率。写出硬件限制和无法推广的结论。
task.en: Explain the benefit and cost of one configuration change, including memory, tail latency or errors. Document hardware limits and conclusions that may not generalize.

evidence.zh: 提交一页技术复盘，链接到代码、配置和测试记录。
evidence.en: Publish a one-page retrospective linking code, configuration and measurements.

subtitle.zh: 理解请求模式如何影响性能

description.zh: 通过可控的重复前缀请求，观察缓存复用与工作负载之间的关系。
description.en: Use controlled shared-prefix requests to explore the relationship between cache reuse and workloads.

outcome.zh: 一份前缀缓存实验与源码阅读笔记
outcome.en: A prefix-cache experiment and source notes

title.en: Trace a request through the code

task.zh: 固定一个 release 或 commit，查找调度与前缀缓存相关入口。画出请求路径并解释缓存复用的前提。
task.en: Pin a release or commit. Locate scheduling and prefix-cache entry points, draw a request path and explain the prerequisites for reuse.

evidence.zh: 提交带固定 commit 链接的源码阅读笔记。
evidence.en: Publish source notes with links to a fixed commit.

task.zh: 构造长度相近的共享前缀和不共享前缀请求。控制缓存初始状态、并发与输出长度，比较 TTFT 和吞吐；说明 tokenizer 对前缀一致性的影响。
task.en: Create similarly sized requests with and without shared prefixes. Control initial cache state, concurrency and output length. Compare TTFT and throughput and explain tokenizer effects.

evidence.zh: 提交请求生成器、版本信息与对比记录。
evidence.en: Publish a workload generator, versions and comparison records.

task.zh: 选择一个与直觉不一致的结果，提出假设，改变一个变量重测。可将有价值的文档修正作为社区贡献，不要求必须合入上游。
task.en: Choose a surprising result, propose a hypothesis and rerun with one variable changed. A useful documentation fix can become a contribution; an upstream merge is not required.

evidence.zh: 提交复现步骤、解释与仍未解决的问题。
evidence.en: Publish reproduction steps, an explanation and unresolved questions.

subtitle.zh: 理解计算、内存与传输的取舍
subtitle.en: Explore compute, memory and transfer trade-offs

description.zh: 连接推理引擎与 KV cache 管理，研究缓存卸载、复用和端到端收益。
description.en: Connect inference engines with KV cache management. Investigate offloading, reuse and end-to-end trade-offs.

outcome.zh: 一份缓存方案评估与复现实验
outcome.en: A cache-design evaluation and reproducible experiment

task.zh: 按当前官方兼容说明选择引擎与 LMCache 版本，记录 CUDA、模型、连接器和存储后端。画出 KV cache 在各层之间移动的路径。
task.en: Choose engine and LMCache versions using current official compatibility guidance. Record CUDA, model, connector and storage backend. Map how KV cache moves between tiers.

evidence.zh: 提交版本表、配置说明和数据流图。
evidence.en: Publish a version matrix, configuration notes and data-flow diagram.

task.zh: 保持负载相同，对比关闭缓存、冷缓存和热缓存三种情况。记录 TTFT、命中情况、内存占用与传输开销，解释何时缓存不划算。
task.en: Keep the workload fixed and compare cache disabled, cold cache and warm cache. Record TTFT, hits, memory and transfer costs. Explain when caching is not beneficial.

evidence.zh: 提交配置、原始记录与收益边界分析。
evidence.en: Publish configurations, raw measurements and an analysis of the benefit boundary.

task.zh: 讨论缓存容量、淘汰、服务重启与故障回退如何影响结果。把未实验验证的判断标为假设。
task.en: Discuss capacity, eviction, restarts and fallback behavior. Label claims you have not tested as hypotheses.

evidence.zh: 提交设计说明，区分测量结果、推断与后续计划。
evidence.en: Publish a design note separating measurements, inferences and future work.
